text:
</sub>  Snapshot fixture hashes when loading campaign inputs

If either fixture file changes while a model request is running, these rereads hash the new bytes even though the campaign continues using the `manifest` and `changedFiles` objects parsed before the run. A long sweep-off leg can therefore claim a fixture identity it never reviewed, and a subsequently started sweep-on leg can even report the same hashes while reviewing different content. Capture the raw bytes and hashes when the inputs are initially loaded, then reuse that immutable identity for every record.
